project_name: GuardianX Enterprise: Autonomous High-Rise Life Safety & InsurTech Command Center
app_type: dashboard (enterprise command center / SOC tactical dashboard)

layout_and_structure.container: min-h-screen bg-[#0b0f19] text-slate-100 font-sans antialiased flex flex-col p-4 md:p-6 gap-6

header_bar.wrapper: flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-800 shadow-2xl
header_bar.status_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono font-semibold animate-pulse
header_bar.view_switcher: flex items-center bg-slate-950/80 p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800
header_bar.toggle_button_active: px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 text-xs font-mono font-bold tracking-wider transition-all duration-200 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(6,182,212,0.2)]
header_bar.toggle_button_inactive: px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 text-xs font-mono font-medium transition-all duration-200
header_bar.action_button: px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(239,68,68,0.4)] transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-2

kpi_banner.card_critical: p-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md border border-red-500/40 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden
kpi_banner.card_warning: p-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md border border-amber-500/40 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.15)] flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden
kpi_banner.card_cyan: p-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md border border-cyan-500/40 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(6,182,212,0.15)] flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden
kpi_banner.card_emerald: p-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md border border-emerald-500/40 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.15)] flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden

view_1_tactical_command.camera_matrix_container: lg:col-span-7 xl:col-span-7 flex flex-col gap-4 p-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-800
view_1_tactical_command.camera_feed_box: relative aspect-video rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 group hover:border-slate-700 transition-all shadow-inner
view_1_tactical_command.triage_queue_container: lg:col-span-5 xl:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-4 p-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-800

view_2_executive_insurtech.interactive_slider_section: p-6 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-cyan-500/30 flex flex-col gap-6 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(6,182,212,0.1)]

testing_and_data_attributes.guideline: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal controls, and key metric displays MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode glassmorphism theme using slate #0b0f19 base with glowing borders and backdrop filters.
Support full stateful simulation when 'Simulate Incident (Floor 14)' is clicked (triggers live alert banner, visual camera hazard pulses, SAR dispatch modal, and audio/toast notification).
Implement the interactive insurance premium slider ($200k to $2M) with real-time 20% discount calculation in Executive InsurTech & ROI view.
Provide modal/toast for 'Export Underwriting Risk Packet' and 'Authorize SAR Dispatch' actions.
Ensure seamless responsive switching between Tactical Command and Executive InsurTech views.
